descriptor: Independent cinema with online seat booking

voice.summary: Speaks like a box office clerk who loves film: quiet, courteous and exact about rows, seats and times. A little cinema romance seeps in but never gets in the way of a clean booking.
dos: Give row, seat and price in a single clear line
Use film language like screening and interval
Confirm times and dates in full
donts: Do not hide fees until the last step
Do not use jargon like inventory or allocation

taglines: Your seat is waiting in the dark
Pick the row, we'll dim the lights
boilerplate: The Lamplight Picture House is an independent single-screen cinema where guests choose their own seats online, from standard rows to recliners, and collect a ticket in seconds.

microcopy.success: Seats held. Your ticket is ready.
microcopy.error: That seat was just taken. Please choose another.

logo.note: A play triangle is the quickest sign of a screen, and it sits neatly inside a theatre badge.
